answer_sheet.Objects to remove: The papers and the empty takeaway cup only.
answer_sheet.Objects to keep: Keep the laptop, coffee mug and tangled cables in their original positions.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Natural photo edit, original wide framing, free-tier resolution.

must_haves: The papers and empty takeaway cup are absent.
The laptop, coffee mug and tangled cables remain visibly intact in their original positions.
Exposed desk areas have believable surface texture and lighting, without leftover object fragments.
The original wide framing and surrounding home-office scene are preserved.

style.prompt: Edit this exact desk photograph. Remove all loose papers, including the printed sheets in the foreground and the papers behind the laptop, and remove the empty disposable takeaway cup on the right. Reconstruct the exposed wooden desktop naturally with matching wood grain, perspective, light and shadows. Leave the laptop completely unchanged. Leave the white ceramic coffee mug completely unchanged. Preserve every cable exactly, including cables crossing over or near the papers, with their original paths and appearance. Preserve the rest of the scene, composition, camera angle, background and lighting. Only remove papers and the disposable takeaway cup; do not remove the ceramic mug or cables.
